title: Privacy breach: local documentation shouldn't include Travis build status
body:
As discussed in #284.

The documentation available at http://gpiozero.readthedocs.org/en/latest/ includes the Travis build status. This is useful.

The build status shouldn't be included in the documentation intended to be read offline, specifically in the Debian package of documentation.
author: Participant 1
